description: Agent Doorbell: ack queue items after the agent replies, drafts or reacts in Slack, and keep it from ending a turn with claimed items unresolved. Both hooks act only in an agent folder (one with a .doorbell-agent file), do nothing if the doorbell command is missing, and always exit 0.

hooks.command: command -v doorbell >/dev/null 2>&1 && doorbell hook post-tool-use || true
command -v doorbell >/dev/null 2>&1 && doorbell hook stop || true
